title: Compute Instance IBB - agnostic input contract

requesterIdentity.description: Authenticated caller identity (a non-human identity for automation) (CON-009).

correlationId.description: End-to-end traceability across portal, orchestrator, pipeline, IaC, resource (CON-009, EVD-003).

changeReference.description: Approved change record reference. Required by policy for environment: prd (SBP AWS-008); enforced conditionally in the pipeline, not the schema.

requirements.description: Agnostic, capability-specific knobs, nested by the fixed high-level categories (sizing/access/resilience/security/operations) from requirement-dictionary/requirement-properties.yaml, per scaffold-ibb SKILL.md §1b. Do NOT put dataClassification here — it is a mandatory context field, already required above.

computeTier.description: Abstract compute sizing tier — how much vCPU/RAM the instance gets. Never a literal instance type.

networkExposure.description: Whether the instance is assigned a public IP (public) or stays internal-only (private).

availabilityZoneIndex.description: Ordinal zone placement within the region; must resolve to the same zone as the target subnet.

terminationProtection.description: Whether the instance is protected against accidental termination via the provider's API.

encryptionRequired.description: Whether a customer-managed key (via the key-management dependency) is mandatory for the root volume, vs. platform-default encryption. The root volume is always encrypted either way.

subnetId.description: Identifier of the subnet (from the subnet capability dependency) this instance is launched into.

osFamily.description: Operating system family; drives platform-approved base image selection internally. Never a literal AMI id.
